assistant.outOfScope: Do not answer medical, legal, political, or unrelated questions.

documents.title: About Digital Pylot
documents.content: Digital Pylot is the UK's leading digital-first car rental platform. We offer instant online search, comparison, and booking with 60-second confirmation and contactless mobile key access. Our vision is to deliver maximum safety, total price transparency, and premium convenience across all major UK hubs.

documents.title: How Booking Works
documents.content: Booking with Digital Pylot takes 3 simple steps: 1) Select your pickup and drop-off UK location. 2) Choose rental start and end dates/times. 3) Select your preferred vehicle and complete instant checkout. Upon booking, you receive a unique booking reference code (format BK-XXXXX), vehicle details, pickup directions, and a digital key pass.

documents.title: Pickup Hubs & Airport Locations
documents.content: Digital Pylot operates 24/7 at major UK airports and city centers: London Heathrow (Terminals 2, 3, 4, 5 - main hub), Manchester Airport (T1 & T2), Birmingham Airport, Liverpool John Lennon Airport, and Leeds Bradford Airport. One-way rentals between any of these hubs are fully supported with flexible drop-off points.

documents.title: Vehicle Fleet & Models
documents.content: Digital Pylot features a modern fleet: 1) TOYOTA Corolla Hybrid (Economy Sedan, 5 seats, 45 GBP/day, 65 MPG). 2) HONDA Accord Touring (Executive Sedan, 5 seats, 85 GBP/day). 3) AUDI A4 Sedan (Premium Quattro AWD, 5 seats, 110 GBP/day). 4) JAGUAR F-PACE (Luxury SUV, 5 seats, 195 GBP/day). 5) BMW X5 xDrive (Luxury AWD SUV, 5 seats, 210 GBP/day). 6) TESLA Model S (Electric Performance, 5 seats, 375m range, 260 GBP/day). 7) MERCEDES-BENZ S-Class (Exclusive Chauffeur Sedan, 5 seats, 310 GBP/day). 8) PORSCHE 911 Carrera (Sports Coupe, 2 seats, 385 HP, 340 GBP/day).

documents.title: Pricing, Payments & Security Deposit
documents.content: Prices are quoted in GBP per day with a Best Price Guarantee and zero hidden card fees. Accepted payment methods: Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay, and PayU. Security deposits are pre-authorized on credit card: £200 for standard/economy cars, £500 for luxury/sports cars, fully released upon undamaged vehicle return.

documents.title: Insurance & Protection Plans
documents.content: Every rental includes Third-Party Liability, Collision Damage Waiver (CDW), Theft Protection, and 24/7 UK-wide AA/RAC Breakdown Recovery. Customers can upgrade to Zero-Excess Premium Cover for £15/day to eliminate all damage excess and cover windshield, tires, and underbody.

documents.title: Driver Requirements & Age Rules
documents.content: Drivers must present a valid UK, EU, or recognized International driving licence held for at least 1 year, plus photo ID (passport) and proof of address. Minimum driver age is 21. Drivers aged 21-24 incur a £15/day young driver surcharge. Premium models (Porsche 911 & Mercedes S-Class) require driver age 30+.

documents.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) & Charging Policy
documents.content: All electric vehicles (such as Tesla Model S) are handed over with at least 80% battery charge. Rentals include complimentary access to the UK Tesla Supercharger network and a Type 2 charging cable. EVs should be returned with at least 20% battery charge.

documents.title: Mileage Allowance & Fuel Policy
documents.content: Standard rentals include 200 free miles per day (extra miles charged at £0.20/mile). Unlimited mileage can be added for £10/day. Fuel policy is Full-to-Full: cars are provided with a full tank and should be returned full to avoid refueling charges.

documents.title: Pickup, Return & Contactless Keys
documents.content: Digital Pylot offers 24/7 contactless self-service pickup. Unlock vehicles directly via mobile app or smart key lockers at airport terminals. Standard daily checkout time is 10:00 AM. A 30-minute grace period is provided for returns; late returns exceeding 30 minutes incur a 1-day rental charge.

documents.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
documents.content: 100% free cancellation with full refund up to 24 hours prior to pickup for Economy, Sedan, and SUV tiers. Luxury and Sports models allow free cancellation up to 48 hours before pickup. Cancellations are processed instantly online or via support.

documents.title: Add-ons & Extra Services
documents.content: Available add-ons during checkout: Satellite GPS Navigation (£5/day), Child / Booster Seats (£8/day), Additional Drivers (£10/day per driver), and European Cross-Border Travel Pass (£35 flat fee for travel to Ireland or Mainland Europe).

documents.title: Customer Support & Contact
documents.content: Digital Pylot support is available 24/7 via UK Toll-Free Helpline (0800-PYLOT-UK / +44 20 7946 0912), live website chat, or email (support@digitalpylot.co.uk). Website sections: Home (/), Vehicles (/vehicles), Booking (/booking), Admin (/admin/dashboard).

documents.title: Pylot AI Vehicle Matcher
documents.content: Pylot AI analyzes customer trip descriptions (passenger count, luggage, terrain, budget, luxury preferences) and scores the live vehicle fleet in real time to recommend the top 3 best-matched cars with instant booking links.

documents.title: Admin Fleet Management Portal
documents.content: Staff and administrators can access the portal at /admin/dashboard to monitor real-time weekly revenue, fleet utilization rates, active bookings, recent transaction feeds, and regional city rental analytics.
